description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_Font, which is responsible for validating and processing the CSS 'font' shorthand property within the HTMLPurifier library. It contains methods for construction, validation, and internal handling of font-related CSS attributes.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_Font
classes.description: Class for validating CSS 'font' shorthand property in the HTMLPurifier library. Handles parsing and validation of font-style, font-variant, font-weight, font-size, line-height, and font-family.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with CSS component validators retrieved from the provided configuration.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a given font shorthand string, parsing individual font components and returning a normalized string or false if validation fails.
